title: MuxRay bounded desktop diagnostic snapshot v4
description: Independent of CLI reports. At most 2 MiB UTF-8 including a trailing newline. Coordinates and request identities use canonical decimal strings. May contain AMF text and at most 4 KiB retained source bytes. Trend issues are local display observations. The capture checks an existing source-change latch without restatting or reading the source. Version 2 adds the selected completed-summary media curve page (at most 64 points), while freezing the retained codec detail field tree, including any selected MP3 frame and H.264 comparisons. No source reread or reanalysis is performed. Version 3 additionally freezes only the selected retained H.264 search page, at most 64 rows and 256 scanned Tags. NAL-header observations are not corruption findings or decodability proof. It preserves the page cursor, indexed coverage, unknown reasons and original source coordinates without launching or resuming a search. Version 4 freezes a retained MP3-change or SEI-message search page. Cursor strings are opaque server identities, never source positions. A SEI page can drain buffered rows with no new reads or scanned Tags. All observations remain bounded syntax evidence, not corruption or decodability proof.
